name: Rattimir
description: Rattimir was a planet located in a star system next to Vardos, a world in the Jinata system of the Core Worlds within grid square L-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The girl Deeta Kardon was from Rattimir, but joined a Vardos Star Scouts troupe in Kestro City on Vardos during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
lead_paragraphs: Rattimir was a planet located in a star system next to Vardos, a world in the Jinata system of the Core Worlds within grid square L-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
